design.issue: ISSUE B — the operator board is static and mute during a node run: stage cells show only id/label/DONE|CURRENT|PENDING, nothing on the board or in the chat changes for the minutes a node runs, no per-node elapsed/cost/tool activity is shown or even recorded, and the /kpi status overlay closes on any key instead of letting the operator select a stage and inspect what it did.
design.root_cause: Three gaps compound. (1) No refresh trigger while a node runs: installWidget (control-plane.ts:325-336) builds one BoardModel and wraps it in a component; the only rebuild path is dependencies.onStateChange (control-plane.ts:483-485), which gated-loop awaits after writeState at the end of a superstep (gated-loop.ts:1518-1519, after engine.runSuperstep() at :1396 returns), at runLoop's initial write (:1910) and after resumeLoop's terminal write (:1776). board-component.ts:38 refresh(model) exists but nothing calls it, so the board is frozen for the whole duration of an agent node. (2) No per-node data exists to draw: the engine sets nodeState.status = "running" only in memory (engine.ts:1324-1334) and checkpoints at the end of the superstep (:1412-1414) or on retry backoff (:1149); GraphNodeRunState (schema.ts:161-181) has no startedAt/elapsed/cost/model; recordSessionCost (engine.ts:816-825) computes a per-node cost delta and folds it into sessionCostUsd, discarding the per-node figure, and it runs once per attempt from executeNode's finally (:1000) inside the executeWithRetries loop (:1132-1134); the only per-node signal on disk is tool.request (policy.ts:963-971, node stamped from job.state.node) and nobody counts it. EVENT_TYPES/EventInput (append-log.ts:9-33, :83-151) and event.schema.json (:15 oneOf) have no node lifecycle type — the real run .kpi/runs/20260903-fix-claude-model-requests-failin-42986cfa/events.jsonl has 261 tool.request records and zero node.* records. (3) The board model has no activity slot and the overlay has no input model: stageCells (board.ts:239-251) emits three fixed lines, telemetryRegion (:464-476) has no activity row, and showStatus's overlay implements handleInput() { done() } (control-plane.ts:366-368). A verified constraint shapes the fix: while `/kpi <goal>` runs, the interactive main loop is blocked in `await this.session.prompt(userInput)` (interactive-mode.ts:1188-1191, the handler is awaited at agent-session.ts:1360) and further input is queued in pendingUserInputs (interactive-mode.ts:3176-3179) because the main session is neither streaming nor compacting (graph nodes run on sdk sessions, engine.ts:567) — so `/kpi status` cannot open mid-run and the always-on widget, ticking on its own setInterval, is the only live surface; the interactive overlay serves live-but-paused jobs (NEEDS_HUMAN/interrupted), which is exactly when an operator inspects what a stage did before approving.

Batch loop: runs += 1 only when status !== 'running' (a killed-and-resumed node keeps its run number), status = 'running' in memory, countRound(), then Promise.allSettled(executeWithRetries) at :1338 — no event, no start time.
settled results are folded at :1339-1352; rejected handling (exhaust/fail) starts at :1354 — node.finished must be appended between them.
executeWithRetries loops executeNode per transient attempt; executeNode's finally (:1000) calls recordSessionCost once per attempt, so per-node cost must be summed across attempts, not overwritten.

Exports: `interface NodeActivity { node: string; status: 'pending'|'running'|'completed'|'failed'; runs: number; startedAtMs?: number; elapsedMs?: number; costUsd?: number; model?: string; toolCalls: number; toolsByName: Record<string, number>; lastTool?: string; result?: string; session?: string; error?: string }`; `foldActivity(records: Iterable<EventRecord>, nowMs: number): Map<string, NodeActivity>` — every node.started record sets status running, startedAtMs = Date.parse(ts), runs = record.run, model, and resets toolCalls/toolsByName/lastTool (a resumed running node re-emits node.started with the same run, so counts restart at the resumption); node.finished sets status, elapsedMs = elapsed_ms, costUsd = sum of cost_usd across records for the node, result, session, error; tool.request increments toolCalls/toolsByName[record.tool] and sets lastTool = shortTool(tool, path) (attribution is record.node; exact for single-agent-node supersteps, which both shipped graphs are); a running node's elapsedMs = max(0, nowMs - startedAtMs). `stageActivities(byNode: Map<string, NodeActivity>, nowMs): Record<string, StageActivity>` keyed by BOARD_STAGES key via stageIndex(node) (nodes with stageIndex -1 are dropped; several nodes on one stage: sum toolCalls/cost, merge toolsByName, the latest-started node supplies status/runs/elapsed/lastTool/model/node/result/session/error). `interface ActivitySnapshot { records: readonly EventRecord[]; nodes: Map<string, NodeActivity>; stages: Record<string, StageActivity>; unreadableLines: number; readError?: string }` and `interface ActivityReader { read(eventsPath: string, nowMs: number): Promise<ActivitySnapshot>; last(): ActivitySnapshot | undefined }`; `createActivityReader(): ActivityReader` keeps { path, offset, records, unreadableLines, inflight }: read() coalesces — while a read is in flight every caller awaits the same promise (mirrors withAppendLock's chain, append-log.ts:398); stat the file; ENOENT → empty snapshot (records [], no error); size < offset (truncated/rotated) → reset to 0 and re-read; else read only bytes [offset, size) with an fs.open handle, keep any trailing partial line unconsumed (offset advances to the last newline), JSON.parse complete lines, count unparsable lines into unreadableLines (never throw); any other fs error is caught and reported as readError = the errno code (or message) with the previous records kept. `narrateRecord(record: EventRecord): { text: string; level: 'info' | 'warning' } | undefined` — node.started → `K-π ▶ 03 plan · run 1 · openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol` (stage id from stageIndex, omitted when -1; model segment omitted when absent), node.finished completed → `K-π ■ 03 plan done · 3m12s · $0.42 · stack.json` (cost/result segments omitted when absent), failed → `K-π ✕ 03 plan failed · 3m12s · <error cut to 80 chars>` level warning, accounts.failover → `K-π ⇄ route <from> → <to>` level warning; every other type (tool.request included) → undefined.

board.ts exports: StageActivity, NodeDetail, formatElapsed(ms), formatCost(usd?), shortTool(name, path?); BoardModel += activity?: Record<stageKey, StageActivity>, eventsUnreadable?: number, eventsError?: string, surface?: 'widget' | 'overlay', selectedStage?: number, detail?: NodeDetail; Span += optional?: boolean; BoardCell += detail?: string[]; RegionId += 'now' | 'nodeDetail' | 'keys'.

Board text contracts: NOW row `NOW <node>  run <n>  <k> tools  ▸ <tool> <basename>  <elapsed>  <cost>  MODEL <provider/id>` (optional spans drop right-to-left: MODEL, ▸ tool, run n; never truncated with '…' while an optional span remains); `NOW <node>  no node.started yet` before the first record; `EVENTS ✕ <n> unreadable` for unparsable lines and `EVENTS ✕ <code>` for a read error; full-layout stage cell detail line `<elapsed> <cost>` (<= 12 chars); overlay NODE panel rows `runs n · elapsed … · cost … · model …`, `tools <total>: name count · …`, `result <name> ● <bytes> B | ○ not written | — none declared`, `session <id>`, `error <text>`, `load error <code>`, `no run yet`; overlay keys row `←/→ select · ↵ detail · q close`. Compact widget height with activity: <= 10 lines at 120 columns, <= 13 at 100; cell detail lines appear only in the full layout.

board-activity.ts exports: NodeActivity, ActivitySnapshot { records, nodes, stages, unreadableLines, readError? }, ActivityReader { read(eventsPath, nowMs), last() }, foldActivity(records, nowMs), stageActivities(byNode, nowMs), createActivityReader(), narrateRecord(record) → { text, level } | undefined.

control-plane.ts exports: `type Ticker = (callback, intervalMs) => stop`; `BOARD_TICK_MS = 1000`; `type ControlPlaneDependencies = LoopDependencies & { tick?: Ticker }` (now comes from LoopDependencies.now); BoardBuildOptions += { now?, activity?: ActivityReader, surface? }; `readNodeDetail(job, snapshot, stage)`. Module state: one ActivityReader and one narration cursor per live job's eventsPath, both dropped when the job is no longer live.

Chat narration (ctx.ui.notify from the widget tick, at most once per record, history before the widget was installed never narrated): `K-π ▶ <NN> <node> · run <n> · <provider/model>`; `K-π ■ <NN> <node> done · <elapsed> · <cost> · <result>`; `K-π ✕ <NN> <node> failed · <elapsed> · <error<=80>` (warning); `K-π ⇄ route <from> → <to>` (warning). No line per tool.request. Latency is bounded by BOARD_TICK_MS.

Overlay keys: ← previous stage, → next stage, Enter toggles the NODE detail panel, q/Esc/Ctrl+C close. The overlay is static (one read on open, detail read on demand) and is reachable only while the main input loop is idle — i.e. on a live paused job; a `/kpi status` typed during a running job is queued by the interactive mode and executes after the job's handler returns.

tests.title: the activity reader reads only appended bytes, coalesces overlapping reads and survives a truncated log
tests.asserts: With a temp events.jsonl: read() then append two lines and read() again → records grows by exactly two and a wrapped fs.open spy shows the second read started at the previous size; two concurrent read() calls resolve to the same snapshot object with no double-counted tool.request; an unparsable middle line increments unreadableLines without throwing; a trailing partial line is not counted until its newline arrives; truncating the file to zero and appending fresh lines yields only the fresh records; ENOENT yields an empty snapshot with no readError; replacing the file with a directory yields readError 'EISDIR' and keeps the previous records; last() returns the latest snapshot.

risks: The widget tick does file I/O every second (state.json read, six stats, one events.jsonl stat and an incremental read of appended bytes only); the first read of a long log (tens of thousands of tool.request lines) folds it once, linear in size, and every later tick is O(appended bytes). Overlapping reads are coalesced into one in-flight promise, so an onStateChange reinstall or a slow disk never double-parses.

tool.request attribution uses record.node, which policy stamps from state.json.node (written at superstep end); both shipped graphs run one agent node per superstep, but a graph with two concurrent agent nodes would count both nodes' tool calls under one node. node.started/finished remain the authoritative per-node timing/cost regardless.

Verified: `/kpi status` cannot be opened while `/kpi <goal>` runs — the interactive main loop awaits the handler (interactive-mode.ts:1188-1191) and queues further input (:3176-3179). The always-on widget (its own setInterval) is therefore the only live surface during a node; the queued `/kpi status` fires after the job returns and, for a finished job, reports 'no active job — last job … DONE'. Opening the overlay mid-run would need a registered shortcut (types.ts:1350 registerShortcut) — see open_questions.

An events.jsonl append failure inside runSuperstep propagates and fails the batch, the same way review.verdict (engine.ts:1113) and emitTerminal do; a run store that cannot be appended to is treated as a broken run, not silently skipped (tool.request's swallow at policy.ts:974 is the deliberate exception for the tool hook, which has no batch to fail).

Adding two records per node attempt to events.jsonl changes record counts; audited tests filter by type (loop.terminal) and none pin totals, but `/kpi verify` output ('N records chained') and any downstream line-counting tooling will see more records.

Compact widget height for a live job grows by exactly one line (NOW row): 9→10 at 120 columns, 12→13 at 100; the activity-less caps pinned by the existing test are unchanged. Cell elapsed/cost lines are confined to the full layout, pending the open question.

Narration relies on ctx.ui.notify; in print/JSON mode there is no widget factory and no notify rendering, so narration is TUI-only (the events.jsonl records remain the durable trail). Narration latency is bounded by BOARD_TICK_MS (1 s) rather than instantaneous.

Failure paths are separate and bounded: unparsable lines → `EVENTS ✕ n unreadable`; fs errors → `EVENTS ✕ <code>` on the board with previous records kept; a tick that throws outside the reader warns once per distinct error code (at most 8 codes) instead of once per process; overlay detail load errors render as `load error <code>` in the NODE panel.
event.schema.json is a shipped resource: forgetting the rebuild fails test/harness.test.ts; the schema-conformance fixture and both EVENT_TYPES copies must be extended or the suites fail.

rejected: 'drop the engine emission and narrate from the widget tick' was accepted only for the callback — the engine still appends node.started/node.finished to events.jsonl (there is no other source of per-node timing and cost); what is removed is GraphEngineOptions.onNodeEvent, LoopDependencies.onNodeEvent, both gated-loop forwardings and the extra installWidget per lifecycle event.

rejected: the minimalism critique's claim that extension commands are 'unlocked' mid-run (agent-session.ts:1344) is wrong for this loop — _tryExecuteExtensionCommand is awaited by session.prompt (:1180), which the main loop awaits (interactive-mode.ts:1188-1191); the immediate paths at interactive-mode.ts:3151-3166 apply only when the main session is compacting or streaming, which a K-π job (sdk sessions, engine.ts:567) never is. The design records the verified behaviour instead, and the 'open overlay during ctx.ui.confirm' case cannot occur because the overlay cannot be open while the handler runs.

rejected: adding agent.denied to the two EVENT_TYPES copies is included (three names in one edit) rather than left stale, because the critique asked for the copies to match append-log.ts and the schema-conformance fixture already covers it; if the reviewer prefers strict scope, drop that one name.
open_questions: Compact-widget height: the design adds only the NOW row (+1 line: 10 at 120 columns, 13 at 100) and keeps per-stage elapsed/cost in the full `/kpi status` board. Should the compact widget's stage cells also carry the `<elapsed> <cost>` line (a further +1 line, 11 at 120), or is the NOW row enough for the always-on surface?

Because a running `/kpi <goal>` holds the interactive command loop, `/kpi status` cannot open mid-run. Is the always-on widget (live, ticking) sufficient during a run, or should a keyboard shortcut (pi.registerShortcut, types.ts:1350) open the overlay while a job runs — and if so, which key?

problems.claim: The shared incremental ActivityReader is unserialized and its `newRecords` ("records appended since the previous read") is single-consumer, but the design gives it three concurrent callers: the widget ticker (guarded only by its own `busy` flag), `onNodeEvent -> installWidget -> buildBoardModel`, and the overlay's `load()`/`readNodeDetail` — all resolving the same reader from the module-level `activityReaders` Map keyed by eventsPath. Two overlapping `read()` calls both see the same `offset`, both parse the same byte range and both push into `records[]`, so toolCalls/toolsByName double-count and `accounts.failover` is narrated twice (contradicting the spec'd test 'a second tick does not repeat it'); conversely a non-narrating read (overlay or onNodeEvent path) that lands between two ticks consumes `newRecords`, so the failover line is silently dropped. The installWidget pseudo-code also references `snapshot.newRecords` although `buildBoardModel` returns only a BoardModel — there is no defined way for the tick to obtain the snapshot.
problems.evidence: Design change (c) for control-plane.ts: `activityReaders = new Map<string, ActivityReader>()` shared by buildBoardModel; tick callback reads `snapshot.newRecords` while calling `buildBoardModel(...)`. Design change (e): `onNodeEvent: async (event) => { ...; await installWidget(ctx, dependencies); }` runs while the ticker is live. board-activity.ts spec: reader 'keeps { path, offset, partial, records[] }' with no lock; compare append-log.ts:395-413 `withAppendLock` which exists precisely because check-then-act on a shared file cursor races. Engine awaits `onNodeEvent` inside runSuperstep (engine.ts:1325-1338 region) so the handler overlaps the 1 s ticker in the same event loop.

problems.claim: The engine test as specified ('injected now advancing 1500 ms per call ... node.finished { elapsed_ms: 1500 }') will not pass with the emission as designed: node.finished takes `ts: new Date(this.now())` and `elapsed_ms: this.now() - startedAtMs` as two separate clock samples, and executeNode's path may call `this.now()` again via readBudget, so elapsed would be 3000+ under a +1500-per-call clock.
problems.evidence: Design change (d) for engine.ts: 'emit node.finished { ts (this.now()), ..., elapsed_ms: this.now() - startedAtMs }'. Existing clock stubs advance per call (test/graph-engine.test.ts:388-394); engine.ts:1176 readBudget also calls this.now().

problems.claim: board.ts and board-activity.ts become a circular value-import pair: stageCells needs formatElapsed/formatCost (value imports from board-activity), and board-activity imports stageIndex/BOARD_STAGES from board.ts. It works only because nothing is evaluated at module top level; a later top-level use (e.g. a const table built from BOARD_STAGES) would throw a TDZ error.
problems.evidence: Design: board-activity.ts 'imports only node:fs/promises, node:path, append-log types, and stageIndex/BOARD_STAGES from board.ts'; board.ts stageCells 'detail = [`${formatElapsed(elapsedMs)} ${formatCost(costUsd)}`]'.

problems.claim: The stated contract 'exactly one started/finished pair per node per batch (retries do not repeat it)' is not the whole story: a node resumed from a `running` checkpoint re-executes without incrementing `runs`, so a second node.started with the same `run` number is appended; foldActivity's 'run-2 resets lastTool/toolCalls' rule keys on run number and will not reset, and elapsed for that run restarts from the second started ts while tool counts accumulate across both attempts.
problems.evidence: engine.ts:1325-1332 — `if (nodeState.status !== "running") { nodeState.runs += 1; }`; design foldActivity: 'node.started sets status running/startedAtMs/runs/model (resets lastTool/toolCalls for a new run)'.

problems.claim: scripts/generate-traceability-map.mjs and test/traceability.test.ts each carry their own hard-coded EVENT_TYPES copy (already missing `agent.denied`), so EVT-node.started / EVT-node.finished map entries do not follow from editing append-log.ts; the design's generator edit adds only the four AC rows and leaves the event list copies stale. traceability.test.ts still passes (the two copies agree with each other), but the map will not carry the new event contracts.
problems.evidence: scripts/generate-traceability-map.mjs:1129-1152 `const EVENT_TYPES = [...]` (22 entries); test/traceability.test.ts:15-38 identical local copy; generator :1759-1776 loops that local list to emit EVT-* entries; append-log.ts:9-33 has 23 entries.

problems.claim: Two evidence citations are slightly off: gated-loop.ts:1776 is resumeLoop's post-terminal `onStateChange` (runLoop's initial write is :1910), and the schema assertion 'adding approved:true to node.finished is rejected' belongs to the existing test 'event schema rejects cross-type and research vocabulary drift' (:180), not to 'one valid normalized branch per event type'.
problems.evidence: gated-loop.ts:1770-1777 (writeTerminalState then `await dependencies.onStateChange?.()` inside resumeLoop); :1910 in runLoop; test/schema-conformance.test.ts:169-189.

required_changes: Make the activity reader safe for the three callers that share it: serialize `read()` per reader with an internal promise chain (mirror append-log.ts withAppendLock) or coalesce an in-flight read so overlapping callers await the same result; and replace single-consumer `newRecords` with a monotonic cursor (e.g. snapshot.records with a sequence index, or `read(path, now, { since })`) so the widget ticker narrates every accounts.failover exactly once regardless of overlay/onNodeEvent reads in between. Define concretely how installWidget's tick obtains the snapshot (return it from buildBoardModel or expose reader.last()); the current pseudo-code references an out-of-scope `snapshot`.

In engine.ts, sample `this.now()` once when building node.finished and derive both `ts` and `elapsed_ms` from that sample; rewrite the graph-engine test expectation to match the clock stub's actual call count (or use a controllable clock that is advanced explicitly between started and finished) instead of asserting a literal 1500.
Move formatElapsed/formatCost/shortTool into a leaf module (or into board.ts) so board.ts does not value-import from board-activity.ts while board-activity.ts imports board.ts.

Document (and make foldActivity handle) the same-run repeat of node.started after a kill/resume of a `running` node: either key the reset on (run, startedAt) or state that counts accumulate across attempts of one run; adjust the contract sentence 'exactly one pair per node per batch' to say 'per batch; a resumed running node re-emits node.started with the same run'.

Add "node.started" and "node.finished" to the EVENT_TYPES copies in scripts/generate-traceability-map.mjs (:1129) and test/traceability.test.ts (:15) so EVT-node.* entries are generated and asserted, then regenerate docs/traceability-map.json (note the copies already lack agent.denied; keep them consistent with append-log.ts).
Correct the two citations (gated-loop.ts :1910 for runLoop's initial onStateChange; place the `approved: true` rejection in the existing 'rejects cross-type and research vocabulary drift' test).

problems.claim: Two code paths do the same job: the engine gains `onNodeEvent`, LoopDependencies forwards it at two construction sites, and the control plane narrates + re-runs installWidget from it — while the same design already narrates accounts.failover from `snapshot.newRecords` on the widget tick, which sees node.started/node.finished the same way within one BOARD_TICK_MS.
problems.evidence: Design change (c) engine `emitNodeEvent` → `await this.options.onNodeEvent?.(event)` in runSuperstep (engine.ts:1325-1345 batch loop); change (d) gated-loop forwarding at :1654 and :1891; control-plane (c) `for (const record of snapshot.newRecords.filter(type === 'accounts.failover')) ctx.ui.notify(...)` and (e) `onNodeEvent: async (event) => { notify; await installWidget }`. The AC text the design itself writes (AC-16.7) only requires refresh 'at least every 2 s'. The callback is also unguarded: an exception from ctx.ui.notify/installWidget propagates out of runSuperstep and fails the node, contradicting the doc comment 'never affects routing'.

problems.claim: node.finished.cost_usd is wrong for any run with a transient retry: `this.nodeRunCostUsd.set(node.id, delta)` in executeNode's finally overwrites on every attempt, so the recorded cost is the last attempt's delta only, while the design promises exactly one started/finished pair per run with retries folded inside.
problems.evidence: engine.ts:1121-1150 `executeWithRetries` loops `await this.executeNode(node)`; :1000 `finally { this.recordSessionCost(session) }` runs once per attempt; design change (b) stores with `.set`, not `+=`, and only deletes after node.finished. Isolated-mode nodes get a fresh session per attempt (engine.ts:898 `disposeAfter: isolated`), so each attempt's delta is the whole attempt cost.

problems.claim: A visual-contract decision is made silently: the always-on compact widget grows from 9 to 11 lines at 120 columns and from 9 to 12 at 100 (three-line stage cells plus a NOW row) for every live job, and the design rewrites docs/visual-targets.md §2 to match — but open_questions is empty.
problems.evidence: Design risks: 'operators on short terminals lose two chat rows'; board-frame change 'Height contract with activity present: compact 120 columns = 11 lines'; fixes.md FX-01 landed 'The always-on widget is 9 lines running at 120 columns'. docs/visual-targets.md §2 Honesty (lines 119-129) is the operator-surface authority; AGENTS.md 'Stop, do not improvise' and this lens require the trade-off (per-cell detail line in the widget vs NOW row only vs overlay only) to be put to the human, not chosen by the design.

problems.claim: YAGNI: the transcript tail (`t` key, `readTranscriptTail` with a 256 KB bounded read, `findNodeTranscript`, a TRANSCRIPT panel, `BoardModel.transcript`), the per-node `recent` last-8 record ring, h/l vim aliases, Space alias, and an `r` refresh key on an overlay that already reloads every second are not asked for by ISSUE B ('select a stage and inspect what it did' is met by the NODE detail panel).
problems.evidence: Design board-activity.ts exports readTranscriptTail/findNodeTranscript; board-overlay handleInput lists left|'h', right|'l', enter|return|space, 't', 'r'; tests 'a transcript tail returns the last assistant lines from a bounded read'. docs/minimalist.md rung 1 YAGNI; each item adds a test, a docs key table entry and a schema-free contract.

problems.claim: Circular runtime import: board.ts calls formatElapsed/formatCost from board-activity.ts, and board-activity.ts imports stageIndex/BOARD_STAGES from board.ts. FX-01 made board.ts 'pure and import-light'; the two 6-char formatters belong in board.ts (or StageActivity carries preformatted strings).
problems.evidence: Design board-activity.ts: 'imports only … stageIndex/BOARD_STAGES from board.ts'; board.ts stageCells: 'detail = [`${formatElapsed(elapsedMs)} ${formatCost(costUsd)}`]'; fixes.md FX-01 §Change 1 'board.ts, stays pure and import-light'.

problems.claim: Reuse missed: the engine already formats `${this.options.model.provider}/${this.options.model.id}` for bus.spawn; the design adds a second copy in node.started instead of one expression used by both.
problems.evidence: engine.ts:1035 `this.options.model === undefined ? undefined : `${this.options.model.provider}/${this.options.model.id}``; design change (d) 'model: this.options.model ? `${provider}/${id}` : undefined'.

problems.claim: Failure modes are conflated rather than named: any reader I/O error (EACCES, EISDIR, a directory swap) is folded into `unreadableEvents` and painted as 'EVENTS ✕ n unreadable' — the count of unparsable lines — and the tick's catch warns once per process, hiding later distinct failures; overlay `loadDetail` failures other than ENOENT have no branch at all ('transcript — not found' is the only path).
problems.evidence: Design control-plane (b): 'Any reader error is caught and reported as unreadableEvents'; (c) `.catch(error => { if (!refreshWarned) {...} })`; board.ts nodeDetail rows list only 'transcript … | transcript — not found'. AGENTS.md 'Handle the failures your contracts name … Silence is a defect'.

problems.claim: Risk 3 (can `/kpi status` be typed while `/kpi <goal>` awaits the loop) is answerable from the code and should be stated, not deferred to fixes.md: extension command handlers run through `_tryExecuteExtensionCommand` with no busy lock, so the overlay is reachable mid-run; the untested interaction is an open `ctx.ui.custom` overlay when a human node calls `ctx.ui.confirm`.
problems.evidence: packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts:1344-1368 `await command.handler(args, ctx)` with no streaming/busy check; interactive-mode.ts:3151-3166 executes extension commands immediately even while streaming.

required_changes: Drop GraphEngineOptions.onNodeEvent, LoopDependencies.onNodeEvent, the two gated-loop forwardings, and the gated-loop forwarding test; narrate node.started/node.finished/accounts.failover from `snapshot.newRecords` on the existing widget tick (one path), and let the tick's component.refresh be the only repaint trigger — remove the extra `installWidget` per lifecycle event.

Accumulate per-node cost across retry attempts (`nodeRunCostUsd.set(id, (get(id) ?? 0) + delta)`), reset it when node.started is emitted, and add the retried-once case to the engine test asserting cost_usd equals the sum of both attempts.

Move the widget-height trade-off into open_questions: (a) three-line stage cells in the always-on widget (9→11/12 lines), (b) NOW row only in the widget with per-cell elapsed/cost in the overlay, or (c) overlay only. Do not rewrite docs/visual-targets.md §2 height text until the human picks.

Cut the transcript tail (readTranscriptTail, findNodeTranscript, TRANSCRIPT panel, `t` key, BoardModel.transcript), the per-node `recent` ring, the h/l/Space aliases and the `r` key; keep ←/→, Enter, q/Esc/Ctrl+C. Remove the corresponding test, docs key-table entries and AC-16.8 wording.
Put formatElapsed/formatCost in board.ts (or pass preformatted strings on StageActivity) so board-activity.ts depends on board.ts and never the reverse.
Reuse one `modelLabel()` expression in engine.ts for both bus.spawn and node.started.

Name the failure paths separately: reader I/O errors surface as `EVENTS ✕ <errno>` (distinct from the unparsable-line count) and are warned per distinct code, not once per process; overlay loadDetail errors other than ENOENT are shown as `error <code>` in the NODE panel.

State in the design (not fixes.md later) that extension commands are unlocked (agent-session.ts:1344) so `/kpi status` is reachable mid-run, and add a test or explicit note for an open overlay when a human node calls ctx.ui.confirm.
